LanguageData.CE_Tweaks_EnableOverpressure_Tooltip: Apply overpressure effects from Combat Extended explosions.
LanguageData.CE_Tweaks_EnableAutocannonExplosions_Too: Enable blast effects added to selected autocannon AP-HE projectiles.
LanguageData.CE_Tweaks_EnableBlastPropagation_Tooltip: Carry excess explosion or overpressure damage to the connected parent part when a body part is destroyed.
LanguageData.CE_Tweaks_EnableIdleWeaponReloading_Tool: Automatically reload undrafted pawns' weapons only after all higher-priority work is unavailable. Disabling this prevents automatic weapon reload jobs.
LanguageData.CE_Tweaks_EnableLogging_Tooltip: Log overpressure events to the console.
